run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-14T22:24:01Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy corresponds to a real burst of error spans on frontend-proxy itself: its 'ingress' (server) and 'router frontend egress' (client) span series each gained ~93 STATUS_CODE_ERROR counts between the 22:27:00 and 22:28:00 counter samples (596->689 and 530->623). In the same 2-minute view the frontend service logged the failures behind them: 100 error spans on 'executing api route (pages) /api/cart' plus 24 on '.../api/checkout' (124 total, equal to the 124 ingress error spans), with client-span errors on grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem (69.3), grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (30.7), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (24) and 9.3 'tcp.connect' failures. That minute is exactly when the cart Deployment replaced its only pod: new ReplicaSet cart-84889c965d (same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart) created at 22:26:31, old ReplicaSet cart-755465879b scaled 1->0 and pod cart-755465879b-rh5r4 gracefully stopped at 22:26:34, while the new container (started 22:26:33) only logged 'Successfully connected to Redis' at 22:26:47 and its HTTP binding at 22:26:56. cart's own served-request rate collapsed for that minute (GetCart 398->46, AddItem 214->20, EmptyCart 74->10 per 1m view) and recovered at 22:28-22:29. The cart container has no readinessProbe, so Kubernetes considered the new pod Ready the moment its process started and removed the old serving pod immediately, leaving no cart endpoint for ~20s; frontend then returned 5xx on /api/cart and /api/checkout, which frontend-proxy's spans record as errors. The alert payload's own value (0.0111) and its start time (22:24:01) could not be reconciled: the alerting rule is not retrievable from this Prometheus and the span-metric samples available start only at 22:06:00, so the exact window/threshold that produced 0.0111 is unknown.

claims.text: In this Prometheus the only metric families carrying service_name="frontend-proxy" are traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket (the same two are returned when selecting by exported_job="opentelemetry-demo/frontend-proxy"); no envoy/nginx/request metric exists for frontend-proxy.

frontend-proxy's span metrics have exactly two span_names, 'ingress' (SPAN_KIND_SERVER) and 'router frontend egress' (SPAN_KIND_CLIENT), and two status_code values, STATUS_CODE_ERROR and STATUS_CODE_UNSET; the series carry no per-pod label (exported_instance is the otel-collector instance).

Raw frontend-proxy error counters jumped between the 22:27:00 and 22:28:00 samples: span_name="ingress" 596 -> 689 and span_name="router frontend egress" 530 -> 623 (+93 each), after moving only from 582 to 596 between 22:06:00 and 22:27:00; after 22:28:00 the ingress counter rose only from 693 (22:30:00) to 698 (22:43:00).

The 1-minute increase view for span_name="ingress" shows 0 error spans at each evaluated minute from 22:19:00 to 22:25:00, 2 at 22:26:00, 186 at 22:28:00 (the minute 22:27-22:28, against 1108 non-error ingress spans in the same view), then 6, 2, 0, 2, 0, 0, 2, 0, 6 through 22:38:00.

At the evaluation instant 2026-11-14T22:28:00Z (2-minute increase view) the error spans were 124 on frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 124 on 'router frontend egress', while total frontend-proxy span activity in the same 2-minute view was 3533 (≈7% of frontend-proxy spans were errors).

At the same instant frontend recorded error spans on 'executing api route (pages) /api/cart' 100, 'POST /api/cart' 69.3, 'GET /api/cart' 30.7, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 24, 'POST /api/checkout' 24, 'POST' 93.3, 'GET' 30.7 (parent/child spans of the same requests), and on its gRPC client spans grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem 69.3, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 30.7, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 24, plus 9.3 error spans on 'tcp.connect'. The 124 user-facing route errors (/api/cart 100 + /api/checkout 24) equal the 124 ingress error spans.

The cart Deployment performed a rollout at 22:26:31-22:26:34: Deployment cart scaled up replica set cart-84889c965d from 0 to 1 and the ReplicaSet created pod cart-84889c965d-tkxdz (Scheduled 22:26:31, container cart Started 22:26:33); the deployment controller then scaled down replica set cart-755465879b from 1 to 0 and the kubelet stopped pod cart-755465879b-rh5r4 ('Killing', reason 'Stopping container cart', 22:26:34) with a ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete of that pod.

The cart rollout was configuration-only, not an image change: both ReplicaSets cart-755465879b (created 21:55:21) and cart-84889c965d (created 22:26:31) use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart.
The cart Deployment runs replicas=1 with strategy RollingUpdate maxSurge 25% / maxUnavailable 25%, and container 'cart' has neither a readinessProbe nor a livenessProbe (both null).

The replacement cart pod's application was not serving when the old pod was removed: its container started 22:26:33, and its logs show 'Successfully connected to Redis' at 22:26:47.6109121Z and 'Overriding HTTP_PORTS ... Binding to values defined by URLS instead' at 22:26:56.9111852Z, i.e. ~20s after the old pod was killed at 22:26:34.

cart's served-request rate collapsed for exactly that minute (1-minute increase view): POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 398 at 22:26:00 -> 46 at 22:27:00 -> 350.9 at 22:28:00; POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem 214 -> 20 -> 212; POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 74 -> 10 -> 60; Redis HGET 588 -> 144 -> 541; client 'POST' spans 74 -> 10 -> 61.

cart did not report application-level failures: its error-status span counter first appears at 22:28:00 with value 1 and stays 1 for the rest of the window, so cart logged (at most) a single error span while frontend recorded ~100 failed cart calls — consistent with connection-level unavailability rather than cart app errors.

frontend and frontend-proxy were not restarted or replaced during the window: pods frontend-675fd7b5c5-64mj8 (container running since 21:55:22, restarts 0) and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-v4lvt (running since 21:55:23/21:55:26, restarts 0) are Ready with restartCount 0, and their ReplicaSets were created at 21:55:21/21:55:23.

The error-increase query at 22:28:00 returned error series only for frontend, frontend-proxy and recommendation (/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 1.33); no error series were returned at all for the other services including cart, checkout, payment, accounting, currency, email, shipping, product-catalog, ad and fraud-detection.

fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-v48vh restarted after being OOMKilled: last termination reason OOMKilled, exit code 137, finishedAt 22:32:01Z, current container started 22:32:02Z, restartCount 1. Its only error signal (flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream, ~1.1-1.3 per 2m) also occurs at 22:23:00-22:24:00 and 22:33:00-22:34:00, outside the 22:27-22:28 frontend-proxy burst, and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error count was 0 at 22:28:00.
All five nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure=False and DiskPressure=False at query time, and every pod in otel-demo is Running.

Most likely cause: the cart Deployment's rollout at 22:26:31-22:26:34 removed the only serving cart endpoint ~20s before the replacement container was actually serving (Redis connect 22:26:47, HTTP binding 22:26:56), and because the cart container has no readinessProbe the new pod was marked Ready on process start; frontend's gRPC calls to CartService (GetCart/AddItem) and its tcp.connect attempts failed, frontend returned 5xx on /api/cart and /api/checkout, and frontend-proxy recorded those as 124 'ingress' error spans, which is the error-rate signal the RequestErrorRate alert is based on. The support is co-timing of the counter jump (596->689 at 22:28:00), the cart throughput collapse to ~10-13% of normal in that minute, and the absence of any other error source at that instant.

Second candidate for the nonzero reading: a low-level error trickle on frontend-proxy 'ingress' that exists independently of the 22:27-22:28 burst (counter 582 at 22:06:00 rising to 596 at 22:27:00, i.e. ~14 error spans in 21 minutes, and 2-6 per minute after the burst through 22:38:00). If the alert's condition is 'error rate above 0' this trickle alone keeps the series nonzero; the observed ratios (124/3533 ≈ 3.5% over 2m, 186/1294 ≈ 14% in the burst minute, 0.0003 over 5m at 22:24:00) do not reproduce the payload's 0.0111, so the rule's window/threshold is a separate open question.

The 24 frontend error spans on grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder are plausibly the same cart dependency (checkout's order flow calls oteldemo.CartService/GetCart): checkout's span volume was normal (976 spans in the 2m view at 22:28:00) and no checkout error series was returned at that instant, so this link is inferred from the shared cart dependency and is not directly observed on checkout's own spans.

Rejected as the cause of the frontend-proxy alert: the fraud-detection container being OOMKilled (exit 137) at 22:32:01Z. It happened 4+ minutes after the 22:27-22:28 error burst, its flagd EventStream error spans also occur before the burst (22:23:00-22:24:00), and frontend's calls to AdService had 0 error spans at the burst instant, so it is a separate event during the window, not the driver of the frontend-proxy ingress errors.

Rejected as the cause of the cart pod loss: node pressure, eviction or OOM. The old cart pod cart-755465879b-rh5r4 was stopped by a graceful kubelet 'Killing' (reason 'Stopping container cart') immediately after the deployment controller scaled its ReplicaSet 1->0, with no Evicted event and no OOMKilled termination recorded for cart; the new cart container has restartCount 0 and all nodes report no MemoryPressure/DiskPressure.

Give the cart container a readinessProbe (e.g. on its CART_PORT/HTTP endpoint) and livenessProbe, and run replicas>=2 with maxUnavailable 0 so a RollingUpdate cannot terminate the only serving cart endpoint before the replacement is actually accepting gRPC traffic; this is the mechanism that produced the ~20s cart outage observed at 22:26:34-22:26:56.

Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition (expression, window, threshold, 'for') from the Prometheus rule files or Alertmanager config, because this Prometheus exposes no rules, and align the reported value (0.0111) and the 22:24:01 start time with an actual error window before tuning the threshold.

gaps: Alerting rule definition is not available: list_prometheus_rules returned no rules for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and no alerting rules at all, so how the payload's current value 0.0111 was computed and which window/threshold applied is unknown; the payload's firing time 2026-11-14T22:24:01Z precedes the observed 22:27-22:28 error spike by ~3 minutes and could not be reconciled from the metrics (0.0003 error ratio in the 5m view at 22:24:00).

Prometheus samples for the span metrics start at 22:06:00 (earliest point returned); error activity before that is unknown even though the counters were already at 582 (ingress) and 530 (egress) errors at 22:06:00, so an earlier error episode cannot be reconstructed.

Jaeger has no traces for the 22:20-22:45 period: traces_search for frontend-proxy (22:20-22:40, 22:33-22:45), for frontend (22:26-22:30) and traces_search_by_tags error=true for frontend/frontend-proxy all returned no data, and the traces actually returned are from 22:12:26-22:12:27. Therefore gRPC status codes and error messages of the failing cart/checkout calls could not be inspected.

frontend container logs could not be read for 22:24-22:32 (fetch_pod_logs returned zero lines with bytes_read 0), so no application-level error text from frontend is available; checkout logs in the same window yielded no error lines either.

cart's error-span series and checkout's error-span series were absent at the 22:28:00 evaluation instant, so their own error counts during the burst minute are unknown, not zero; checkout's share of the failure is inferred only.
Logs of the terminated cart pod cart-755465879b-rh5r4 are no longer available (pod deleted at 22:26:34), so whether it logged in-flight failures while terminating is unknown.

The change_history integration is not integrated, so what changed the cart Deployment pod template (trigger of the configuration-only rollout at 22:26:31, same image digest) is unknown; kubectl rollout restart vs. a config edit cannot be distinguished.

Kubernetes events for otel-demo in the window begin at 22:26:31; earlier transient events (e.g. around the 21:55 pod creation wave or 22:24) are not available, so other brief disturbances before 22:26 cannot be excluded.
next_steps: Add a readinessProbe/livenessProbe to the cart container and raise replicas above 1 with maxUnavailable 0 (advisory; no change was made in this investigation).
Fetch the RequestErrorRate rule YAML from the Prometheus/Alertmanager configuration to confirm its window and threshold against the observed 22:27-22:28 burst.
Confirm from frontend application logs or a live trace sample that the failed cart calls returned gRPC UNAVAILABLE / connection refused during 22:26:34-22:26:56.
Review change history for the cart Deployment template change at ~22:26:31 to identify the initiating user or pipeline.
Optionally review fraud-detection memory limits given the OOMKilled at 22:32:01Z (separate from this alert).

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). <none> means the path reached no value in that object, not that the field is absent from the kind; a filtered table is not a full picture of the kind.

notes: This tool has no time range: it shows Prometheus's state at the moment of the query, which can be after the authorized window; it cannot show the state when the incident happened.
